name: Default
shortDescription: Browser-based nonlinear video editor built in Rust and WebAssembly: multi-track timeline, color grading, effects, audio mixing and export, with media kept on the user's device.

alerts.message: Projects and media are not stored on the server: the editor runs in the browser and keeps only a recovery snapshot in that browser's storage. Save projects and exports to your own device.
The upstream project publishes no container image; this one is built by a community maintainer from the official releases.
